name: Build a cited editorial review packet from approved sources

parameters.content:
## Configure before activation
Accept approved source excerpts and a topic. Return an editorial packet with exact supporting quotes and source links. Quotes are checked; claim interpretation still needs an editor. No crawling or publishing.

1. Set enabled=true and review model/configuration in Prepare Request.
2. Bind separate Header Auth credentials to ingress and provider. Provider header: x-api-key.
3. Put this behind your own backend and rate limit. Never expose the ingress credential in browser code.
4. Data goes to Anthropic only after configuration. API costs apply.
5. Import inactive. Execution payload saving is disabled. Read the matching guide.
